\section*{Brief Biography}\vspace{-8pt}
\noindent
I hold a Bachelor of Pharmacy from the University of Sydney and a Master of Health Data Science from UNSW. I have over three years of research experience in epidemiology, population health and applied science. \vspace{5pt}

I have experience working with large, linked administrative health datasets. I am passionate in statistical modelling, data visualisation, and data storytelling to translate complex data into meaningful and actionable insights. \vspace{-10pt}

My research interests involve in pharmacoepidemiology and ageing, with a particular focus on developing and applying advanced statistical and analytical methods to large-scale linked health administrative data.

## Peer-reviewed Journal Articles

```{r}
pubs <- get_cv_sheet('pubs') %>%
  mutate(
    journal  = ifelse(is.na(journal), '', paste0('_', journal, '_.')),
    number   = ifelse(is.na(number), '', paste0(number, '.')),
    doi      = ifelse(
               is.na(doi), '',
               paste0('DOI: [', doi, '](', 'https://doi.org/', doi, ')')),
    year     = paste0("(", year, ")"),
    title    = enquote(title),
    citation = paste(author, year, title, journal, number, doi)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(first_author), desc(pub_date))
```


```{r}
#| results: asis

make_ordered_list_filtered(pubs, "peer_reviewed")
```
